Interpretation the page must state: all 49 detail masses were observed, but only 68.76 percent of placement mass was resolved. Those are different coverage questions. The conditional internal ratio is available because resolution clears the 0.50 threshold; unresolved mass enters neither numerator nor denominator. ExternalEvent exceeds the internal total in this synthetic fixture because the waiter/cake/embarrassment chain is genuinely Unresolved by the current induction logic, not because missingness was silently scored as external. The empty mental profile is also meaningful: embarrassment is recorded as an atom but excluded from the target-mass-gated profile because that chain is unresolved.

Visuals warranted by this output: a point-plus-interval category plot with hard counts as labels; a three-part resolved/unresolved/excluded mass bar; and a profile panel that prints missing/empty channels explicitly rather than drawing zero bars. This is enough material for a real Autobiographical Interview walkthrough and makes the difference between observation coverage and placement resolution visible.
